notes: The installer (release asset install-dependency-first-architect-vX.Y.Z.py, run by the README's checked download block) writes the skill package to .claude/skills/dependency-first-architect/ in the project, or ~/.claude/skills with --global: SKILL.md, the reference files it loads on demand (plan template, validation examples, AI layer, layer map) and LICENSE. The same files are the release zip. Invoke with /dependency-first-architect or let the description trigger it.

Generated from SKILL.md by build.py (alwaysApply: false, so it loads when a request matches) with the reference files appended as appendices; the installer writes it to .cursor/rules/dependency-first-architect.mdc. Also a release asset of the same name, for a manual install.

The installer writes the whole skill, reference files appended, to .codex/dependency-first-architect.md, and a ~1 KB block (adapters/codex/AGENTS-snippet.md) into AGENTS.md that tells Codex to read it when a request matches; the rest of AGENTS.md is kept. Not yet tested in Codex. Manual alternative: the release asset codex-AGENTS.md (adapters/AGENTS.md), the method without its reference files, read in every session (about 16 KB).
